caption: The drawing depicts a single wide-brimmed straw hat. The hat is brown in color, with finely detailed lines indicating the woven texture. Around the base of the crown, there is a thick, light yellow ribbon that encircles the hat and is tied into a bow on the left side. Two long yellow ribbons extend downward from the hat, tied together in a loose knot, with the ends hanging freely. The background is plain and off-white, with a slight gradient of beige near the edges. The hat is centered in the composition, and there are no other objects present.
title: Hat
